title: Cyberbullying Screenshot
scenario: Someone asks you to forward a humiliating screenshot to make it go viral.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Cyberbullying Screenshot: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Do not spread harmful content; report it to a trusted adult.
